dc_max_kw.notes: Quick web lookup. Article says the LEAF 'can charge at up to 150 kW'; not stated per trim.

charge_port.notes: Quick web lookup. NACS passenger-side fast-charge port; J1772 on driver's side for AC.

supercharger_access.notes: Quick web lookup. Native NACS port; article says it unlocks Tesla Superchargers across Canada.

published_10_80_min.notes: Quick web lookup. Model-wide figure; pack/trim not stated on the page.

curb_weight_kg.notes: EV Specifications: about 4,369.56 lb (1,982 kg); cars.com and iSeeCars show 4,369 lb for US Platinum+ (x0.45359 = 1,982). EV Specifications does not state its source; the cars.com/iSeeCars figures were not opened by the fact-checker.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Nissan global press kit spec table: 75.1 kWh usable for the 75 kWh LEAF pack. US press kit lists 75 kWh for Platinum+ as well; Canadian Platinum+ assumed identical.

heat_pump.notes: Quick web lookup. Article says heat pump standard; not per trim.

wheels.notes: Quick web lookup. '19-inch wheels' listed for Platinum+.
